dependencies: Python standard library only; no model/training/UI imports
non_comparable_reasons: Native legal enumeration omits affordable purchase at exactly seven bonuses of that color. Adapter retains the common semantic key and stops if it is selected as unsupported_reference_bonus_cap; it never patches the cap or changes random choice weight.

Native generateSuccessor appends mandatory in-memory action_reward history, which native legal generation deep-copies. No logging-disable interface exists. This bookkeeping is timed and conflicts with the logging-excluded benchmark contract.
data_verified: Existing Comparison helper asserts exact functional multiset equality for 90 cards and 10 nobles before import/use.
setup: Inject ordered whole decks and nobles once; remaining deck reversed because native Board.deal pops. No state reset or per-turn draw realignment after setup.
policy: Same semantic sorted keys, SplitMix64 rejection sampler, fixed buy/take/reserve priority. Stops before selected multi-noble buy; no forced pass or cap winner.
validation: Selected compound action membership in already generated native legal list before unchanged Rule.update. Full card partition checked after setup and outside timed gameplay at final snapshot.

smoke.scope: Two 12-turn prefixes from one shared fixture, one random and one fixed; not complete games or a speed result.
smoke.comparison: seal256 unchanged native engine through aligned adapter

measurement: Prepared-state native generation/projection/policy/validation/update and clock/record collection; setup, final state boxing and JSON output outside timer; native in-memory history remains enabled.
limitations: Full-rule blind reservation, optional gold, return, pass, seven-bonus and 3/4-player winner differences remain documented in docs/PARITY.md.
Only tiny trace prefixes were run in this session. No third-engine whole-game ranking is supported.
